problemStatement:
Ceiling-mounted projectors are commonly suspended below a structural ceiling using a vertical support tube and mounting bracket. Under normal service conditions, the combined projector-and-mount weight is assumed to act through the centroidal axis of the vertical tube, so the tube is modeled as a prismatic hollow circular member in axial tension.

The 16.3 kg projector mass and extension-column geometry are anchored in published manufacturer documentation. The 1.7 kg accessory allowance, 750 mm length, steel properties, and required factor of safety are instructional assumptions. None are inferred from a photograph, and the model does not identify or certify a photographed installation.
engineeringGoal: Determine whether the idealized vertical hollow tube satisfies the assigned axial-yield criterion, quantify its axial elongation, and calculate its gross-tube axial capacity. Explicitly distinguish that calculated tube capacity from the allowable capacity of the complete projector mounting assembly.
